product_overview: The product is a React-based document editor application with authentication, an admin dashboard, and a rich-text workspace for creating and managing documents. It is organized into modular features for access control, user administration, and document editing.
core_goals: Log into the application and access the appropriate area based on role
Recover account access by requesting and completing a password reset
View administrative dashboard information as an admin user
Find and review application users from the admin user management page
Create and edit documents in a rich-text workspace with formatting and layout controls

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows a user to sign in with workspace, email, and password credentials and be redirected based on role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in workspace name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the appropriate destination based on role
Navigate to /login -> Fill in workspace name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Toggle password visibility -> Submit the login form -> See the appropriate destination based on role
Navigate to /login -> Submit the login form with missing or invalid values -> See validation messages

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Lets a user request a password reset link using an email address.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit the reset request -> See a success message
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Submit the reset request with an invalid email -> See validation or error messages

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Lets a user set a new password after receiving a reset token.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in new password -> Fill in confirm password -> Submit the reset form -> See a success message
Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in mismatched passwords -> Submit the reset form -> See validation messages

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides an admin home page for reviewing dashboard information and moving to user management.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View dashboard overview -> Navigate to user management

features.name: User Management
features.description: Allows an admin to review and search the application user list.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/users -> View the list of users -> Search or filter users -> Review the matching results

features.name: Document Editor
features.description: Provides the main document workspace for typing, formatting, arranging panels, and accessing document actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> Type and edit text -> Use the toolbar to format text -> View the updated document
Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> Navigate sidebar icons to switch panels -> Continue working in the selected panel
Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> Resize panels using drag handles -> Continue editing with the new layout
Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> View and interact with the document ruler -> Continue editing
Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> Open the chart context menu on a figure -> Review available chart actions
Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> Access header actions to save the document -> Access header actions to share the document -> Access header actions to export the document
Navigate to /editor -> View the document workspace -> View user profile in the header

routes.description: Root redirector - sends user to login or dashboard based on auth state and role

Admin dashboard home page (Admin role only)
